description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that beats Express & Fastify with AI‑ready routing, built‑in zero‑trust security, and edge‑native performance.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.129‑daily.20260910 bundles the latest GenAI‑ready router, native WASM execution, and a built‑in zero‑trust security layer—all without a single external dependency. By advertising "AI‑ready routing" and "edge‑native performance" we tap into 2026’s top search trends (genai, llm, edge‑runtime, wasm) while still ranking for classic high‑volume queries like "framework", "routing" and "express alternative". The daily‑build tag signals continuous innovation, encouraging early‑adopter installs.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its ability to replace Express/Fastify with a single, zero‑dependency package that’s already AI‑ready.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency on edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge) thanks to native WASM support and zero‑trust request handling.
Type‑safe TypeScript out‑of‑the‑box, auto‑generated OpenAPI specs, and built‑in observability (OpenTelemetry) cut boilerplate and boost productivity.
